objective: Compose the landed Telnyx correlation resolver, durable bridge application, canonical attempt executor, and correlated event application service over one caller-provided River CRM D1 persistence boundary.
compositionRules: Accept an already-provided D1-compatible database object.
Construct contact-attempt persistence from that database.
Construct Telnyx call-leg correlation persistence from that database.
Construct Telnyx call-bridge persistence from that database.
Construct the correlated event resolver from correlation persistence and attempt persistence.
Construct the bridge event application service from bridge persistence.
Construct the correlated attempt executor from the same database.
Construct the D3 correlated event application service from those dependencies.
Do not access Astro locals, Cloudflare env bindings, or RIVER_CRM_DB by name.
ownershipRules: Correlation lookup remains owned by the existing correlation persistence and resolver.
Bridge state reads and compare-and-set writes remain owned by the existing bridge persistence and application service.
Attempt compare-and-set and provider-event receipts remain owned by the existing correlated attempt executor.
E2C3E owns composition only and performs no eager database queries.
next: Any webhook or runtime ingress binding remains a separately authorized later slice.
